description: The same two-subsystem task on a small window, so main and its line compact and must still know which line they are
message:
Two independent subsystems need building in this project, and each has its own failing test suite:

- parser/ — the integer expression parser specified in parser/expr.py
- cache/ — the bounded LRU cache with TTL specified in cache/lru.py

They share no code and do not touch the same files. Make `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` pass for both, and keep the implementations to their specs.

params.prompt: Build the parser/ subsystem specified in parser/expr.py so `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_expr.py' -v` passes, keeping to its spec. Do not touch cache/ or tests/test_lru.py.

steers.text: A user line is already building parser/ (parser/expr.py and tests/test_expr.py). Keep main strictly on cache/ (cache/lru.py and tests/test_lru.py): do not open another line and do not edit parser/ files.

afterIdle.request: Re-run the tests of the subsystem you are building and report whether they pass.

probes.text: after a compaction, a line's next request still carries its own identity block
after a compaction a line acts as if it were main or forgets which line it is
